program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_m":  (14.0, 8.0, 20.0),    # bottom mirror pair
    "L_m":     (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "gmid_c":  (18.0, 10.0, 24.0),   # cascode pair: low Vdsat for compliance
    "L_c":     (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),
    "vds1":    (0.15, 0.08, 0.22),   # Vds of bottom devices
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    I = spec.get("iin", 20e-6)
    vnom = spec.get("vout_nom", 0.9)
    vds1 = p["vds1"]

    # Bottom pair (M1 ref side, M2 out side): identical sizing
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_m"], p["L_m"], I, vds=vds1)
    m2 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_m"], p["L_m"], I, vds=vds1)

    # Cascode on ref side: source at vds1, drain at gate node ga (= Vgs1)
    vds3 = max(m1.vgs - vds1, 0.1)
    m3 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_c"], p["L_c"], I, vds=vds3, vsb=vds1)
    # Cascode on out side: drain at nominal output
    m4 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_c"], p["L_c"], I, vds=max(vnom - vds1, 0.1), vsb=vds1)

    # Vb = Vga + I*R ; Vds1 = Vb - Vgs3  ->  R = (vds1 + Vgs3 - Vgs1)/I
    R = max((vds1 + m3.vgs - m1.vgs) / I, 100.0)

    n = Netlist("iin iout vdd vss")
    n.R("RB", "iin", "ga", R)
    n.dev("M3", "ga", "iin", "x", "vss", m3)
    n.dev("M1", "x", "ga", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M4", "iout", "iin", "y", "vss", m4)
    n.dev("M2", "y", "ga", "vss", "vss", m2)

    ro2 = 1.0 / max(m2.gds, 1e-12)
    ro4 = 1.0 / max(m4.gds, 1e-12)
    rout = ro2 + ro4 + (m4.gm + m4.gmbs) * ro4 * ro2
    vcomp = vds1 + m4.vdsat

    # Residual error: node y deviates from x by the cascode Vgs difference
    # (M4 has a larger Vds than M3, so it has slightly lower Vgs through DIBL)
    dv_drain = (vnom - vds1) - vds3
    dvy = dv_drain / max((m4.gm + m4.gmbs) * ro4, 1.0)
    err = 100.0 * abs(dvy) * m2.gds / max(m2.Id, 1e-12) + 0.2
    return n, {"rout": rout, "v_compliance": vcomp, "iout_err_pct": err, "power": 2 * I * 1.8}

events.reason: The error comes from a forbidden token ('input') in comments. Removed it and simplified the error model. The low-voltage cascode mirror with a self-biasing resistor fits: cascode gives Rout >> 7 Mohm,
